label: Project overview
title: FlowSync is a next-gen ACH payment and invoicing platform designed to streamline financial operations for Small and Medium-sized Businesses.
lead: From secure logins to automated invoicing and fraud control, FlowSync puts users back in control of their payments.

blocks.alt: FlowSync dashboard overview on a laptop

label: The problem
title: Users of traditional ACH platforms often face…

items.title: Unclear statuses
items.text: Unclear transaction statuses leading to follow-up delays.

items.title: Manual invoicing
items.text: Manual recurring invoicing, increasing admin burden.

items.title: Limited fraud controls
items.text: Limited fraud controls, exposing businesses to risk.

label: The solution
title: FlowSync simplifies, automates, and secures ACH operations through a human-centered design approach.

blocks.title: How it works
items: One-click invoice creation with recurring payment support.
Customer tokens for fast repeat transactions.

label: My UX design process
title: From user interviews to pixel-perfect delivery.

items.title: Empathize
items.text: Conducted interviews with 7 users (accountants, SMB owners, finance teams). Created empathy maps to understand emotions, goals, and frustrations.

items.title: Define
items.text: Conducted interviews with 7 users (accountants, SMB owners, finance teams). Created empathy maps to understand emotions, goals, and frustrations.

items.title: Ideate
items.text: Created multiple wireframe sketches. Co-designed dashboard and invoice flow with stakeholders.

items.title: Design
items.text: Designed a component-based UI system (accessibility-focused). Used clear call-to-actions and color-coded status tags.

items.title: Prototype & Test
items.text: Built and tested Figma prototypes with 12 users. Iterated based on usability testing feedback.

items.title: Handoff
items.text: Created dev-ready assets with design tokens and documentation. Supported implementation QA to ensure pixel-perfect delivery.

label: Typography
title: Poppins
lead: A geometric sans-serif typeface known for its clean and modern aesthetic. Poppins features balanced letterforms and consistent stroke widths, making it an excellent choice for digital interfaces. Its friendly yet professional appearance enhances readability and brings a sense of approachability to fintech platforms like FlowSync.

label: Final thoughts
title: FlowSync was built to fix what's broken in traditional ACH systems.
lead: By addressing real user pain points, we've created a product that is not only functional but delightful to use. It's a platform that scales with business needs while offering trust, clarity, and ease. I'm excited to bring this level of thoughtful, data-driven design to your next product.
